stories.title: Kiev, 'ci prepariamo a incontro Trump-Zelensky a margine dell'Onu'

en.title: Kiev, 'we are preparing for Trump-Zelensky meeting on the sidelines of the UN'
en.summary: Ukrainian officials anticipate a meeting between Trump and Zelensky at the United Nations that could potentially lead to agreements on energy ceasefire and Black Sea matters.

stories.title: Klopp debutta da ct: "Non lasciamo l'orgoglio nazionale alle persone sbagliate"

en.title: Klopp debuts as coach: "We don't leave national pride to the wrong people"
en.summary: The new German national team coach has called up 44 players for his first four matches and made critical remarks toward the AfD party.

stories.title: Solo a casa a 5 anni, precipita dal balcone: è gravissimo. Denunciato il padre

en.title: Left alone at home at age 5, falls from balcony: in critical condition. Father charged
en.summary: A five-year-old boy fell from a balcony and was airlifted to a Rome hospital in critical condition; his father faces abandonment charges. A separate incident involved a two-year-old in the Verona area.

stories.title: Solo a casa a 5 anni precipita dal balcone, gravissimo

en.title: Left alone at home at age 5 falls from balcony, in critical condition
en.summary: A five-year-old boy fell from a balcony near Rome in a critical state; his father was charged with child abandonment.

stories.title: Garlasco, archiviata a Brescia l'accusa per ex pm Venditti corruzione in atti giudiziari

en.title: Garlasco, corruption charges against former prosecutor Venditti dismissed in Brescia
en.summary: Charges were dropped against a former deputy prosecutor from Pavia who was accused of accepting money to facilitate the dismissal of a case involving Andrea Sempio in 2017.

stories.title: Svezia, vincono di misura i progressisti di Andersson: ma il nuovo governo è un rebus

en.title: Sweden, progressives led by Andersson narrowly win, but new government remains uncertain
en.summary: Swedish progressives won a narrow victory with 176 seats versus 173 for the centre-right after a four-day count. Conservative premier Kristersson resigned, avoiding a far-right alliance, though the radical left's strong showing complicates government formation.

stories.title: Il centro-sinistra vince di misura in Svezia. A Andersson il compito arduo di formare il governo

en.title: Centre-left wins narrowly in Sweden. Andersson faces difficult task of forming government
en.summary: Sweden's centre-left narrowly won the election, with Magdalena Andersson tasked with forming a new government. Observers expect negotiations could take weeks or months to complete.

stories.title: Rabbino aggredito a Milano, un fermo e due denunce

en.title: Rabbi assaulted in Milan, one arrested and two others reported
en.summary: A 20-year-old Tunisian was arrested for assaulting a 60-year-old rabbi at a bus stop in Milan's Piazzale Bande Nere alongside two other youths. He faces immediate court appearance.

stories.title: Il rabbino aggredito a Milano: “Ho avuto paura, ma resto qui e con i miei abiti tradizionali”

en.title: Rabbi assaulted in Milan: "I was afraid, but I stay here in my traditional clothes"
en.summary: A rabbi who was attacked in Milan stated he experiences regular antisemitic incidents on the streets and noted that another rabbi had been assaulted previously, citing growing antisemitism.

stories.title: Quando Meloni diceva: "Abolire il bollo auto? Nemmeno Cetto La Qualunque"

en.title: When Meloni said: "Abolish car tax? Not even Cetto La Qualunque"
en.summary: Meloni previously criticized a proposal to suspend car tax for low-income Calabrian families, but the government has since announced a national vehicle tax exemption for certain vehicle categories based on power rather than income.

stories.title: Guerra Ucraina-Russia, le news. Kiev: “Ci prepariamo a incontro Trump-Zelensky a margine dell’assemblea Onu”

en.title: Ukraine-Russia War, latest news. Kyiv: "We are preparing for Trump-Zelensky meeting on the sidelines of UN assembly"
en.summary: Ukrainian officials indicate preparations for a potential meeting between Trump and Zelensky at the UN assembly, suggesting it could lead to a ceasefire. Russia conducted raids near the border, prompting Poland to issue alerts and scramble fighter jets.

stories.title: Rabbino aggredito a Milano, tre persone già individuate: “Preso a calci e pugni”. Lui li filma

en.title: Rabbi assaulted in Milan, three people already identified: "Kicked and punched". He films them
en.summary: A rabbi in Milan was attacked and managed to photograph the three assailants as they fled before contacting authorities.

stories.title: Agevolazioni, un tesoretto di 46 miliardi sprecati

en.title: Tax breaks, 46 billion in wasted resources
en.summary: PwC analysis suggests unused tax incentives could unlock resources for business growth and hiring. An AI recovery tool identified average savings exceeding 1,500 euros per employee for companies.

stories.title: Economia del mare, occupati a 1,1 milioni e crescita prevista del 7,1%

en.title: Maritime economy, 1.1 million employed and projected growth of 7.1%
en.summary: The maritime economy sector employed 1.1 million people with expected 7.1% growth. Added value from the sector increased over 22% between 2022 and 2024, approaching 79 billion.

stories.title: Ai, raddoppiano le imprese italiane che ne fanno uso

en.title: AI, Italian companies using it double
en.summary: The number of Italian companies adopting artificial intelligence has doubled in the past year, reaching nearly one in five firms at 19.5%. Data comes from recent Unioncamere-Dintec survey findings.

en.title: Caddy's (Dmo) enters Gruppo VéGé
en.summary: Caddy's, a retail chain specializing in personal care, beauty, hygiene, and household products currently owned by Dmo, will join the VéGé system starting January 1, 2027.

stories.title: Gestione stress, lavoro di squadra e comunicazione, l’eredità dei 20mila volontari di Milano Cortina

en.title: Stress management, teamwork and communication, the legacy of Milan Cortina's 20,000 volunteers
en.summary: Randstad's assessment highlights that volunteers from the Milan Cortina Olympics acquired highly sought-after skills that young people can leverage in the job market.
